sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
